message:
I can see the instrumentation. The `OP_ARYCAT` case has `assert_ci_realloc_seen` checks. The vulnerability is that `mrb_ary_splat` can trigger a nested `mrb_vm_exec` (via `to_a` method call), which can cause `cipush` to reallocate `c->cibase`, invalidating the local `ci` pointer. Then the code uses the stale `ci` pointer.

Let me look at `mrb_ary_splat` in array.c:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "mrb_ary_splat" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/array.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
